alerts.description: Potential ransomware encryption behaviour detected on finance workstation
Unusual outbound connections towards rare ASN range
Spike in failed authentication attempts detected on VPN gateway
Data transfer volume exceeded baseline for engineering subnet

incidents.title: Coordinated brute-force attack on VPN gateway
incidents.summary: Multiple hosts generated coordinated brute-force and credential stuffing alerts against the perimeter VPN concentrator.
incidents.description: Analysts observed a surge in authentication failures originating from multiple remote networks targeting the VPN gateway. Rate limiting has been enabled while additional detections are deployed.

incidents.title: Potential data exfiltration via DNS tunnelling
incidents.summary: Indicators of possible data staging followed by exfiltration through DNS were observed on analytics cluster nodes.
incidents.description: Endpoint telemetry indicates staged archives prior to a spike in DNS queries. Outbound firewall rules are being tightened while packet captures are reviewed.

incidents.title: Web application compromise through SQL injection
incidents.summary: Web application logs confirm SQL injection payloads exploited an outdated ORM layer resulting in lateral movement.
incidents.description: The vulnerable endpoint has been isolated and patched. Logs are being reviewed to determine the scope of access and data exposure.

incidents.title: Phishing-driven malware outbreak contained
incidents.summary: Malware beaconing behaviour isolated to marketing workstations following successful phishing campaign.
incidents.description: Affected hosts were rebuilt and credentials rotated. User awareness campaign initiated for impacted business unit.
